comparison.objective: Prepare a moka pot by filling its base below the safety valve, inserting the coffee basket, and fastening the upper chamber; candidate separates ceramic media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1506 tests controlled liquid pouring, fill-level regulation, basket insertion, thread alignment, bimanual stabilization, screwing, and regrasping. Candidate tests bimanual screen agitation, real-aperture passage, retention of larger parts, and support reseating.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1506 requires 122.5–155.8 mL in the base, basket/coffee present, upper chamber straight and snug, limited spill, upright released vessels, and no pot contact; versions refine cross-threading and torque/contact thresholds. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery for completion credit, every washer retained, no spill or invalid passage, dual support, 60 mm hand clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Although both involve loose contents, spill avoidance, bimanual handling, and release, moka-pot assembly does not test size-selective separation through apertures, while the candidate does not test metered pouring, insertion, or threaded fastening.
